analytics.title: Cookie preferences
analytics.description: Essential storage keeps login, bookings and language preferences working. Optional Analytics helps us understand visits and bookings. It stays off unless you accept.
analytics.essentialDescription: Required for authentication, booking sessions, language selection and remembering your privacy choice. Always active.
analytics.analyticsDescription: Google Analytics 4 measures public page visits and booking interactions. No advertising tracking. You can withdraw consent at any time.
analytics.privacyIntro: Information about how 1200 Hairstudio handles website, booking and optional Analytics data.
analytics.providersBody: This website uses service providers for hosting, authentication, bookings, maps and communications. Optional Google Analytics 4 is provided by Google and is loaded only after Analytics consent. The information below describes this optional processing.
analytics.policyBody: With your permission, we use Google Analytics 4 (Google) to understand public page visits and booking interactions. Google receives technical browser/device information and processes your IP address to deliver the service. Our events contain only public page categories, language, site mode and fixed interaction types. We do not send names, email addresses, telephone numbers, booking references, appointment identifiers, notes, authentication tokens, query strings or URL fragments in our tracking payloads. Advertising storage, advertising user data, ad personalisation and Google signals are disabled. Google may process data outside Switzerland and the EEA, including in the United States. See Google’s privacy policy for its processing and safeguards.
analytics.cookiesBody: Analytics is optional and remains unloaded until you opt in. Rejecting it does not affect login, booking or other essential functions. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time using Cookie Preferences. Your consent choice is stored locally for 180 days. Google Analytics cookies (_ga and _ga_*) are configured for up to 180 days. Consented booking-success events use a local, hashed duplicate marker for up to 180 days; it is never sent to Google. Withdrawal stops further tracking and removes Analytics cookies and duplicate markers from this browser. Data already received by Google is not automatically deleted by withdrawal; GA4 reporting retention is managed separately in the Analytics property.
analytics.bookingSystemBody: Online appointments are handled through the website’s booking system with Supabase authentication and database storage. Booking details are used to reserve and manage appointments and send related service communications. Analytics is optional and is not required to book.
analytics.acceptedMessage: Your cookie preferences have been saved. Analytics permission is granted.
analytics.rejectedMessage: Your cookie preferences have been saved. Analytics is disabled.
